reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits when I'm cramming at 1am. I'm not going to gamble an exam night on a yerba mate with 80 mg that might feel weaker, and I'm not ordering cans from an e-shop when my usual is at every corner shop.
objection: The label is all in English, so I'm not even sure it's a Czech brand, and 80 mg of caffeine from mate sounds like it won't keep me going the way my regular drink does.
would_change_my_mind: A free can at a café near the library during exam season so I could feel for myself whether it actually keeps me awake without the crash.
